contentText: The deputy director of the European Council on Foreign Relations' Paris office has spoken to FRANCE 24 about how European nations are already being sucked into the war in Iran. Camille Lons pointed out that although any direct help for the US or Israel has been labelled as only defensive, attacks on French and British bases have already occurred. She noted that other major issues such as energy prices and the provision of weapons – bearing in mind European requirements for supplies to Ukraine – could also be impacted if the war goes on. She spoke to us in Perspective.
